title: Rabbi Elazar of the South
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was the student of Rabbi Yose (Rabbi Yonah’s colleague), as in Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:2, where he asked before Rabbi Yose. In Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:2: “Rabbi Elazar of the South said: Did not Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Zeminah say in Rabbi Yochanan’s name?” In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 1, end of halakhah 1: Rabbi Elazar of the South in the name of Rabbi Shemi. Hyman says that Seder HaDorot confused Rabbi Elazar of Rome and Rabbi Elazar of the South together.

notes.text: The consulted Peah 8:2 has Elazar of the South asking before Rabbi Yose. The teacher relationship and the charge that Seder HaDorot conflated two figures remain Hyman’s conclusions.
